image_description: A two-story red brick building featuring 'The Mill Bakery' on the ground floor. The facade includes a large display window with baked goods visible inside, a central glass door entrance, and a white signboard with black text above the shopfront. Upper floors have three sash windows with curtains. An archway is visible to the left of the bakery.
